items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: like our president and Bolsanaro and Putin. You know they’re the ones that are having the worst pandemic experiences.

ctx.x: There’s always a way to manipulate the system. This is a fairly deep question. I wonder if you have an opinion about the government response to this pandemic either from the local or state — © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

Absolutely. Absolutely yes. I mean if you compare all the countries in the world, you know the dictatorial types, like our president and Bolsanaro and Putin. You know they’re the ones that are having the worst pandemic experiences. We don’t have it together. All these programs that were set up to prepare for a pandemic were cut out of the budget systematically over the years. Even the governor, as good a job as he’s doing in some ways, had cut out also, funding to hospitals for Medicaid, had cut out many, many…
Have you lost any friends through the pandemic?
